The '''Rothana shipyards''' were a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]]. The orbital shipyards and drydocks were operated by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the existence of the Rothana shipyards was one of KDY's best-guarded secrets. Defended by the [[KDY corporate-security starfleet/Legends|KDY corporate-security starfleet]], the shipyards were responsible for the construction of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ships]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the location of Rothana and its shipyards was unveiled as the planet fell under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control. By the time of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it was considered as one of the 67 major shipyards of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
